rationale: David's work shipping real-time infrastructure for production robotics at LiveKit directly complements Kshitij's deep expertise in semiconductor IP verification and protocol design—the low-level systems that enable real-time communication at scale. While their technical stacks differ (WebRTC/ROS vs. SystemVerilog/UVM), David's conviction that production robotics requires purpose-built observability infrastructure and Kshitij's track record delivering under tight deadlines on mission-critical protocols suggest potential value in exploring how hardware verification rigor could strengthen the reliability requirements David sees in autonomous systems.
intro_message: David Chen, meet KSHITIJ GUPTA — you're both deep in the infrastructure layer of complex systems (real-time comms for robotics vs. semiconductor IP verification), and there may be useful cross-pollination on how hardware-level protocol robustness applies to the observability and reliability challenges David is solving at LiveKit.
